messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Julia Garcia <julia.garcia@acme-corp.com>

Subject: OKR closure: annotated grades and QBR playbook for sign-off

Team — attaching the annotated grades workbook and the QBR playbook we will use with Acme next week. This is the final closure email ahead of the QBR; I need explicit sign-off (or documented objections) by EOD MON (12/13) so we can lock slides and the customer-facing narrative.

Background/context: we followed the two-step process we agreed in leadership offsite — quantitative score (0-1 scale, normalized across teams) then a qualitative adjustment where owners justify +/- 0.1 for material context (resourcing, incidents, dependencies). The attached spreadsheet includes both the raw numbers, the adjustment rationale, and a one-paragraph narrative per objective.

High-level calls I've made in the sheet:
- Serving Reliability: 0.84 -> adjusted to 0.78 due to two sustained incidents in Nov and slower recovery on eu-west region. Rationale on tab "Reliability".
- Latency / Cost: 0.92 (no adjustment). We hit throughput targets and unit cost improvement.
- Sales/Expansion: 0.69 -> adjusted to 0.75; pipeline quality was stronger than forecast.

Asks:
1) Please review the "Annotated Grades" tab and confirm any edits inline (track changes in the sheet or reply here with a single bullet per requested change).
2) Confirm the narrative box for each objective — we will not alter customer-facing wording after 12/13.
3) Action owners: I listed rollforward owners in column H — if you are tagged, please confirm capacity to deliver by Q1 check-in.

Two small edits I want leadership alignment on before sign-off:
- Whether we soften the reliability narrative to emphasize mitigations and roadmap items rather than the lower grade. My view: be transparent (keep 0.78) but lead with roadmap and SLO commitments.
- Whether to promote the model quantization initiative in the expansion narrative; Monica suggested elevating it.

Attachments: 2026Q4_OKR_annotated_grades.xlsx (workbook, per-objective tabs), QBR_playbook_v3.pdf (customer deck framework and timing).

I'll compile all inputs into a decision log and final slide pack on Tues morning.

Thanks —
Alex Martinez
Head of Platform Product
Redwood Inference

--
